SELECT json_build_object(
  'backup_date', now(),
  'tables', json_build_object(
    'leagues', json_build_object('count', (SELECT count(*) FROM leagues WHERE id != '00000000-0000-0000-0002-000000000002'), 'data', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM leagues t WHERE id != '00000000-0000-0000-0002-000000000002')),
    'rounds', json_build_object('count', (SELECT count(*) FROM rounds WHERE league_id != '00000000-0000-0000-0002-000000000002'), 'data', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM rounds t WHERE league_id != '00000000-0000-0000-0002-000000000002')),
    'submissions', json_build_object('count', (SELECT count(*) FROM submissions), 'data', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM submissions t)),
    'votes', json_build_object('count', (SELECT count(*) FROM votes), 'data', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM votes t)),
    'profiles', json_build_object('count', (SELECT count(*) FROM profiles), 'data', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM profiles t)),
    'family_groups', json_build_object('count', (SELECT count(*) FROM family_groups WHERE id != '00000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000001'), 'data', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM family_groups t WHERE id != '00000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000001')),
    'group_members', json_build_object('count', (SELECT count(*) FROM group_members WHERE group_id != '00000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000001'), 'data', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM group_members t WHERE group_id != '00000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000001')),
    'season_competitors', json_build_object('count', (SELECT count(*) FROM season_competitors WHERE group_id != '00000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000001'), 'data', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM season_competitors t WHERE group_id != '00000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000001')),
    'round_awards', json_build_object('count', (SELECT count(*) FROM round_awards), 'data', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM round_awards t)),
    'group_messages', json_build_object('count', (SELECT count(*) FROM group_messages WHERE group_id != '00000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000001'), 'data', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM group_messages t WHERE group_id != '00000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000001')),
    'group_settings', json_build_object('count', (SELECT count(*) FROM group_settings WHERE group_id != '00000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000001'), 'data', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM group_settings t WHERE group_id != '00000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000001')),
    'invites', json_build_object('count', (SELECT count(*) FROM invites), 'data', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM invites t))
  )
) as backup
INSERT INTO json_backups (backup_date, backup_data) VALUES (NOW(), $1::jsonb) RETURNING id, backup_date

## ML Companion Daily Backup (Simple)

**Credentials:**
- Export: TML_Supabase_direct
